method: Downloaded Gutenberg plain text (19322-8.txt), sliced from Nietzsche's AUTHOR'S PREFACE through 'THE END', stripped all front/back matter and Gutenberg legal boilerplate, merged lone aphorism-number lines into following paragraph, normalized blank-line paragraph spacing.
anomalies_found_and_fixed: Stripped Gutenberg license header/footer, Borzoi Pocket Books ad list, title/copyright page, table of contents, and H. L. Mencken's translator Introduction essay (kept Nietzsche's own AUTHOR'S PREFACE through THE END).
Merged 62 standalone aphorism-number marker line(s) (e.g. '12.') into the start of the following paragraph so numbering doesn't sit alone as its own tiny block.
Source uses ISO-8859-1 encoding with CRLF line endings; decoded and normalized to UTF-8 with LF line endings.

62 numbered aphorisms confirmed present (1-62); no roman numeral or PART/CHAPTER divisions exist in this work, so 'PREFACE' is the only heading and the aphorisms form a single chapter body, consistent with the original book's structure (a continuous polemic, not divided into parts).

Nietzsche's own all-caps signature line ('FRIEDRICH W. NIETZSCHE.') closing his preface is detected as its own (near-empty) heading/chapter by the all-caps short-line heuristic in build_chapters(); left as-is since it is genuine original text (not boilerplate) and the same heuristic already produces similar single-line chapters elsewhere in this repo's other library texts.
